entities.summary: Susan Elizabeth Rotolo, known as Suze Rotolo, was an American artist and political activist. From 1961 to 1964, she was in a relationship with musician Bob Dylan. Dylan later acknowledged her strong influence on his music and art during that period. Rotolo is the woman walking with him on the cover of his 1963 album The Freewheelin' Bob Dylan, a photograph by the Columbia Records studio photographer Don Hunstein. In her book A Freewheelin' Time: A Memoir of Greenwich Village in the Sixties, Rotolo described her time with Dylan and other figures in the folk music and bohemian scene in Greenwich Village, New York.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a key figure in the Greenwich Village bohemian scene and Bob Dylan's personal life, Suze Rotolo played a significant role in shaping the folk music movement of the 1960s. Her relationship with Dylan influenced his early work and contributed to the cultural and artistic landscape of the era.
